$Comment: The last rung of Marn's Edge, and the one that pays the hatchet: a long shift for the essence
that tempers the head, then the leather and the concentrated essence to bind it.
find_essence counts life essence the Sawmill hands over (STATION_OUTPUT, exact id, qualified to
the Sawmill, so essence from any other source does not count) and long_shift is WORK_STATION
on the station id, real cycles only; both sit on Order 1 and fill through the same shift.
bring_leather and bring_essence are Order 2, exact-id hand-ins to Marn only (TurnInNpcId
'giver'). Flow.HideLockedSteps keeps those two off the step list until the shift is behind the
player, so the quest reads as the work it is asking for. The two heavy leather are the count
the vanilla cobalt hatchet's own recipe asks for; the concentrated essence is the mill's deep
find and the Standing Order's rarest roll, so the three asked for here are earned at the block
Rewards sit in Claim: Marn's Hatchet itself (Item/Items/MMO_Tool_Hatchet_Marn.json, whose stats
and cut are tuned in that file) and Woodcutting XP. The Chains entry files it as tier 3 of
marns_edge. Completing this quest is also what the Marn's Own achievement counts, so a retune
here changes what that achievement asks. Remove the Item entry and the questline is a plain
XP arc; point it at another item id to hand over a different tool.
Name: The_Fitting
